Unity-Technologies/skills.2d-pixel-perfect: No 2D content: the repo is an Editor-only package.
Unity-Technologies/skills.asset-transformer-toolkit: No 3D model or point cloud imports.
Unity-Technologies/skills.build-gtk: Needs Unity 6000.6+ (the package supports 6000.3+), and there is no graph tooling.
Unity-Technologies/skills.build-live-game: No live game or Unity Services backend.
Unity-Technologies/skills.generate-editor-search-query: No scenes or assets to search.
Unity-Technologies/skills.project-auditor-fixes: Needs Project Auditor and its rules package in the host project; too heavy for a small Editor-only codebase.
Unity-Technologies/skills.ui: Only Editor UI here, which ui-uitk already covers; the router adds little.
Unity-Technologies/skills.ui-imgui: No IMGUI code, and the skill itself sends new Editor UI to UI Toolkit.
Unity-Technologies/skills.unity-package-management: Adds packages to a project through the Client API; this repo authors a package instead.
